name: Icon Block
description: Grid of small icons paired with labels or short text — for feature lists, trust signals, or capability grids. Use when there are uniform icon + label pairs arranged in a grid. Don't use for a single large feature callout (use aside or columns).
visualSignals: Uniform grid of icon + label pairs. Icons are roughly equal size. Often 2–4 items per row.

rows.note: colspan=2; for multi-column grids pair with section-metadata two-up / three-up / four-up

cols.contains: h3 feature name + p short description + optional a link

domInput.notes: Each item is one <tr> with two <td> cells (icon + text). Repeat one <tr> per item. Use 'vertical' variant for icon-above-text layout, 'bio' for circular avatar style, 'inline' for same-line icon+text. For multi-column icon grids, pair with section-metadata: two-up / three-up / four-up.
